captures.description: A HETERONYM RECOVERED WITH A FABRICATED CORPORATE AFFILIATION. Emily Antioch the Twin is identified against The Gospel of Antioch. But the SciLynk card renders the byline as «LSLee Sharks · EDGEWELL PERSONAL CARE (UNITED STATES)» — a razor and personal-care manufacturer, attached as institutional affiliation, with the creator's name mangled to «LSLee».
